The weighted campus energy balance calculator passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating robust logic for multi-source energy integration.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.85 across one trial with zero exceptions. The pytest suite in test_output.py passed successfully in 0.297 seconds, confirming the accuracy of the energy balance calculations. Future iterations should maintain this weighting logic while ensuring edge cases in energy source variability are explicitly handled.
